title: A store creates a room once under its id, answering the room as it was given, and refuses a second creation under that id, keeping the room it holds
notes: Python: tests/test_store_room_contract.py, a room created once; roomkit-rs testing::check_conversation_store (rooms). The second creation names another organization and other metadata, so a store that replaced or merged the room shows it. Not observed: for RK-14.1-007, the id the framework gives the room it builds (§10.1 step 2's or a fresh one), which is the kit's, not the store's.
